source.detail: openai OAS corridor pair 5162af98d314 -> 117ce5680e42 (breaking subset ingested 2026-08-01)

spec_evidence.checked: Walked both cached specs: OLD requestBody.content for POST /skills/{skill_id} lists application/json and application/x-www-form-urlencoded; NEW lists application/json only. The endpoint itself survives in NEW with the same method, so only the form-encoded request wire format is withdrawn.

alternative_data_source: the same endpoint accepts application/json request bodies in the NEW spec

fix.migration_guide: Switch the request body encoding at every call site that POSTs /skills/{skill_id} as a form: replace application/x-www-form-urlencoded submission (URLSearchParams / form-data key-value bodies with the form content-type header) with a JSON body — set the Content-Type header to application/json and JSON.stringify the same parameters. Official openai SDK clients already send JSON and are unaffected; only raw HTTP callers using form encoding break.
fix.example_before: await fetch('https://api.openai.com/v1/skills/{skill_id}', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }, body: new URLSearchParams(params) });
